parameters.name: smsEnabled
parameters.description: Set to true to enable SMS support

parameters.name: smsOriginationNumberId
parameters.description: The ID of the Origination Phone number you want to use.  Can be found in the End User Messaging SMS console.

parameters.name: smsSNSTopicArn
parameters.description: The ARN of the SNS Topic to be used when configuring your SMS Origination Number for 2-way SMS. If not provided, a new SNS Topic will be created and assigned to the SMS Origination Number.

parameters.name: smsConfigurationSet
parameters.description: The configuration set to use for the SMS messages.

parameters.name: whatsappEnabled
parameters.description: Set to true to enable WhatsApp support

parameters.name: whatsAppBusinessAccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the WhatsApp Business Account you want to use.  Can be found in the End User Messaging Social Messaging console.

parameters.name: whatsappOriginationNumberId
parameters.description: The ID of the WhatsAppOrigination Phone number you want to use.  Can be found in the End User Messaging WhatsApp console.

parameters.name: whatsappSNSTopicArn
parameters.description: The ARN of the SNS Topic to be used when configuring your WhatsApp Business Account. If not provided, a new SNS Topic will be created and assigned to the WhatsApp Business Account.

parameters.name: emailEnabled
parameters.description: Set to true to enable Email support

parameters.name: useBedrockKnowledgeBase
parameters.description: Set to true to use Bedrock Knowledge Base for the chatbot.

parameters.name: bedrockKnowledgeBaseId
parameters.description: The ID of the Bedrock Knowledge Base you want to use.  Can be found in the Bedrock console.

parameters.name: useBedrockAgent
parameters.description: Set to true to use Bedrock Agents for the chatbot.

parameters.name: bedrockAgentId
parameters.description: The ID of the Bedrock Agent you want to use.  Can be found in the Bedrock console.

parameters.name: bedrockAgentAliasId
parameters.description: The ID of the Bedrock Agent Alias you want to use.  Can be found in the Bedrock console.

parameters.name: useAgentCoreRuntime
parameters.description: Set to true to deploy and use an AgentCore Runtime for the chatbot. The runtime is created automatically from the sample-agentcore-agent/ source code.

parameters.name: deployAPIStack
parameters.description: Set to true to deploy the API Stack.

parameters.name: apiAllowedOrigins
parameters.description: Please provide the domain of your web application, to allow CORS. For example: https://aaaabbbbcccc.cloudfront.net

parameters.name: conversationFirehoseStream
parameters.description: The name of the Firehose Stream to use for storing conversation history.

tags.project: AWS End User Messaging GenAI Chatbot
